# pve_sdn_zone (Resource)

SDN zone configuration (any zone type: simple, vlan, qinq, vxlan, evpn, faucet).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_sdn_zone" "example" {
type = "evpn"
zone = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Plugin type. One of: `evpn`, `faucet`, `qinq`, `simple`, `vlan`, `vxlan`.
- `zone` (String) The SDN zone object identifier.

### Optional

- `advertise_subnets` (Boolean) Advertise IP prefixes (Type-5 routes) instead of MAC/IP pairs (Type-2 routes).
- `bridge` (String) The bridge for which VLANs should be managed.
- `bridge_disable_mac_learning` (Boolean) Disable auto mac learning.
- `controller` (String) Controller for this zone.
- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `dhcp` (String) Type of the DHCP backend for this zone One of: `dnsmasq`.
- `disable_arp_nd_suppression` (Boolean) Suppress IPv4 ARP && IPv6 Neighbour Discovery messages.
- `dns` (String) dns api server
- `dnszone` (String) dns domain zone  ex: mydomain.com
- `dp_id` (Number) Faucet dataplane id
- `exitnodes` (String) List of cluster node names.
- `exitnodes_local_routing` (Boolean) Allow exitnodes to connect to EVPN guests.
- `exitnodes_primary` (String) Force traffic through this exitnode first.
- `fabric` (String) SDN fabric to use as underlay for this VXLAN zone.
- `ipam` (String) use a specific ipam
- `lock_token` (String) the token for unlocking the global SDN configuration
- `mac` (String) Anycast logical router mac address.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU of the zone, will be used for the created VNet bridges.
- `nodes` (String) List of cluster node names.
- `peers` (String) Comma-separated list of peers, that are part of the VXLAN zone. Usually the IPs of the nodes.
- `reversedns` (String) reverse dns api server
- `rt_import` (String) List of Route Targets that should be imported into the VRF of the zone.
- `secondary_controllers` (List of String) Additional controllers.
- `tag` (Number) Service-VLAN Tag (outer VLAN)
- `vlan_protocol` (String) Which VLAN protocol should be used for the creation of the QinQ zone. (default: 802.1q) One of: `802.1q`, `802.1ad`.
- `vrf_vxlan` (Number) VNI for the zone VRF.
- `vxlan_port` (Number) UDP port that should be used for the VXLAN tunnel (default 4789). (default: 4789)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: zone (also the `terraform import` format).
